cases.situation: Recruiter wants a call about a Staff Engineer role but won't give the salary range, just 'it's very competitive, let's discuss on a call'. My floor is $190k base.
cases.reply: I understand. To save us both time, my floor for a move is $190k base. If the role is in that range, I'm happy to book a call this week; if not, I'll pass for now.
cases.note: State the number instead of asking a third time. A recruiter who still won't engage has told you about the role.

cases.situation: 猎头在脉脉上找我，说一个大厂的高级产品经理岗位。我刚跳槽4个月，不想动，但这个猎头挺专业的，想保持联系。
cases.reply: 谢谢您想到我。我刚换工作四个月，现阶段不考虑新机会，明年六月前后很愿意再聊。我们先在这里保持联系？
cases.note: "暂时不考虑"要带一个时间点，不然对方会当成委婉的拒绝。

cases.situation: Told a recruiter twice I'm not interested in contract roles. He's messaged me three more times this week with contract gigs.
cases.reply: As I mentioned, I'm not looking for contract roles. Please remove me from your outreach list. Thanks.
cases.note: Second clear no, no reason needed. Then stop replying.

cases.situation: A recruiter, Nadia, emailed that before she passes me to the hiring manager she needs my current salary. I make $128k and I'm targeting $150k base. I'm interested in the role.
cases.reply: Thanks, Nadia, glad this is moving. I'd rather not share my current salary, but I can tell you what I'm targeting: $150k base for this role. If that fits the band, I'm happy to speak with the hiring manager this week; Thursday or Friday afternoon works for me.
cases.note: Share the target, never the current number; stay clearly interested so the redirect doesn't read as a no.

cases.situation: Gestern hatte ich ein Erstgespräch mit Frau Keller, Recruiterin bei einer Unternehmensberatung, für eine Senior-Consultant-Stelle. Klang gut, aber die Rolle hat 60 Prozent Reisetätigkeit und das passt mit meinen zwei kleinen Kindern nicht. Ich heiße Jana Hoffmann und will höflich absagen.
cases.reply: Guten Tag Frau Keller, vielen Dank für das Gespräch gestern. Ich habe es mir gut überlegt und möchte die Stelle nicht weiterverfolgen: 60 Prozent Reisetätigkeit passt in meiner jetzigen Lebensphase nicht. Wenn Sie eine vergleichbare Rolle mit überwiegend regionalen Projekten haben, höre ich sehr gern wieder von Ihnen. Viele Grüße, Jana Hoffmann
cases.note: Absage nach dem Gespräch: die Antwort in den ersten zwei Zeilen, ein kurzer Grund, und eine konkrete Tür für passende Rollen.

cases.situation: 去年10月猎头周小姐找过我一个高级数据分析岗位，我当时婉拒了，说保持联系。现在公司在裁员，我想主动找她，想找上海电商或金融公司的数据团队负责人，年薪期望55万左右，但不想显得很急。
cases.reply: 周小姐您好，去年10月您联系过我聊高级数据分析的机会，当时时机不合适，谢谢您还记得我。我现在开始看新的机会，方向是电商或金融公司的数据团队负责人，base上海，年薪期望55万左右。如果您手上有合适的，这周四或周五下午都方便电话聊15分钟。
cases.note: 主动回头找猎头：直接说方向、城市和薪资，方便她匹配；裁员的事不必解释。

cases.situation: Recruiter Maya from a fintech shared the band for a Senior Data Engineer role: $140k to $155k base. I'm on $160k now and wouldn't move for under $175k. The role itself sounds good.
cases.reply: Thanks for sharing the band, Maya. It's below what I'd need to move; my floor is $175k base. If there's flexibility on that, I'm happy to talk this week. If not, no hard feelings, and please keep me in mind for roles at that level.
cases.note: Give your floor, not your current pay, and leave one clear door open.

cases.situation: Recruiter Sam wants to put me forward for an operations manager role at Keystone Logistics and asked if I'm interviewing anywhere else. I'm in final rounds with one other company and don't want to name it, and I don't know Keystone's range yet. I'm free for a call Tuesday 6 October or Wednesday 7 October in the morning.
cases.reply: Thanks, Sam, I'm interested in the Keystone role. Yes, I'm in final rounds with one other company; I'd rather not name it, but I'll tell you as soon as anything changes. Could you share the base range before we go further? If it lines up, I'm free for a call Tuesday 6 October or Wednesday 7 October in the morning.
cases.note: Answer the other-process question honestly without naming the company; never invent an offer to create urgency, recruiters compare notes.

cases.situation: An in-house recruiter at a health-tech company, Marcus, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior QA lead role. I'm happy where I am, but my former colleague Tanvi Rao, who led QA on our mobile apps for three years, is job hunting and would be great for it. Later on I'd consider engineering management roles.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Marcus. This one isn't for me, I'm not looking right now. A former colleague, Tanvi Rao, led QA on our mobile apps for three years and is open to new roles; I'll check with her today and, if she's keen, introduce you both by email. Feel free to keep me in mind for engineering management roles later on.
cases.note: A no can still be useful to them: answer first, and offer a referral only after checking with the person you're naming.

cases.situation: ビズリーチ経由で、エージェントの田中さんから物流系SaaS企業のプロダクトマネージャー職のスカウトが来た。自分は山本。興味はあるけど、自分はPM歴5年で今は3人のチームのリード。募集要項を見るとメンバークラスっぽいので、面談の前にレベル感と年収レンジを確認したい。
cases.reply:
田中様
ご連絡ありがとうございます。物流領域には関心があり、前向きに検討したいと考えています。面談の前に2点確認させてください。1点目はポジションのレベルです。現在PMとして5年、3名のチームのリードをしておりますので、リード以上のポジションを想定されているかを伺えますか。2点目は想定年収レンジです。この2点が合うようでしたら、10月6日（火）か7日（水）の19時以降にお話しできれば幸いです。
よろしくお願いいたします。
山本
cases.note: レベルと年収レンジを面談前に聞いておけば、合わない場合にお互いの時間を使わずに済む。

cases.situation: 一个猎头在脉脉上联系我，是深圳一家互联网公司的高级前端岗位，方向我挺感兴趣。但我听说他们是大小周，我现在不考虑大小周。想在约电话前先问清楚。
cases.reply: 谢谢您想到我。这个方向我挺感兴趣的，约电话前想先确认一点：这个岗位是双休还是大小周，平时一般几点下班？我目前不考虑大小周的团队。如果是双休，这周三或周四晚上8点后都可以通话。
cases.note: 硬性条件在约电话之前问，一句话说清楚底线，对双方都省时间。

cases.situation: An agency recruiter, Liam, messaged that he'd 'love to put me forward' for a product analyst role at Harbor Health. Before I replied, Harbor Health's HR emailed saying they'd received my CV from his agency. I never agreed, and I might have wanted to apply directly.
cases.reply: Hi Liam, thanks for thinking of me. I've just heard from Harbor Health's HR that my CV reached them through your agency, and I hadn't agreed to that. Please don't send my CV anywhere without my written okay first. If you have other roles that fit, I'm happy to hear about them and decide each one with you.
cases.note: Keep the reply in writing. A submission you didn't approve can complicate applying directly, so tell the company's HR yourself if you want to go direct.

cases.situation: An agency recruiter, Owen, called my desk phone at work this morning with my manager sitting right next to me. I said I couldn't talk and he emailed my personal address after. I'd actually like to hear more, just not on that line.
cases.reply: Hi Owen, thanks for reaching out, and sorry I was brief this morning. I'm open to hearing about the role, but please don't call my work number; this email is the best way to reach me. Could you send the base range and location first? If those line up, I'm free for a call Thursday after 6.
cases.note: Move the channel in the first reply and still ask for the range before the call. A recruiter who keeps ringing your desk after this is telling you how he works.

cases.situation: A recruiter, Kelly, says her client is about to offer me a project manager role and wants me to confirm now that I'll accept if it's $120k base. That's in my range, but I haven't seen the benefits or met the manager I'd report to. I could meet the manager Monday 5 October or Tuesday 6 October.
cases.reply: Thanks, Kelly, good to hear it's moving. I'm very interested, and $120k base is in my range, but I can't commit to accepting before I've seen the full written offer, including benefits, and met the manager I'd report to. Could you set up a 20-minute call with them on Monday 5 October or Tuesday 6 October? I'll give you a clear answer within two working days of getting the written offer.
cases.note: Say yes to the number, not to the offer: a promise to accept that you later break costs you more with the recruiter than a clear condition now.

cases.situation: A recruiter, Hannah, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior backend role at a fintech in Amsterdam. I'm Canadian, based in Toronto, and would need visa sponsorship and help relocating. I'm genuinely interested.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Hannah, this sounds interesting. Before we book a call: would the company sponsor a work visa for a Canadian and offer relocation support, and what's the base range in euros? If those line up, I'm free for a call Tuesday or Thursday at 9am Toronto time.
cases.note: For a move abroad, sponsorship is the dealbreaker, so ask it before the call alongside the range.

cases.situation: A recruiter, Priya, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior UX researcher role at a healthcare company. I'm on parental leave until January 8 and can't start before February 1, but I'm genuinely interested. I'd rather not interview until December.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Priya, this sounds interesting. I'm on parental leave until 8 January, so the earliest I could start is 1 February, and I'd rather hold interviews until December. If the team can work with that timing, could you share the base range? If it lines up, I'd be glad to set up a call in the first week of December.
cases.note: Timing is the dealbreaker, so it goes first; the dates are all the detail about the leave you owe.

cases.situation: A recruiter, Tom, messaged me on LinkedIn about a data scientist role at Calloway Insurance. I interviewed there in March and was turned down after the final round because I lacked experience with pricing models. I've spent the six months since building pricing models in my current job, and I'm interested.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Tom. I'm interested. Worth flagging up front: I interviewed at Calloway in March and didn't get past the final round, mainly on pricing model experience, which is exactly what I've spent the last six months building in my current role. Could you check the team is open to seeing me again? If so, I'd be glad to set up a call this week.
cases.note: Naming the earlier rejection yourself beats having the recruiter find it in their system.

cases.situation: 猎头陈先生在领英上联系我，推荐一家“头部物流公司”的供应链数据经理岗位，从描述看就是我现在的公司，很可能就是我们组正在招的岗位。我不打算动，但他挺专业，以后想保持联系。
cases.reply: 陈先生您好，谢谢您想到我。从描述看，这个岗位应该就在我现在的公司，所以这次就不考虑了。以后如果有其他公司供应链数据方向的机会，欢迎随时联系我。
cases.note: 答案放在前两行，不用多解释，也不要透露公司内部招聘的情况，最后留一扇门。

cases.situation: Recruiter Aaron messaged me on LinkedIn about a regional sales director role at Norvale, a direct competitor of my current employer. I'm interested, but my contract has a six-month non-compete clause for competitors. I want to know if that's a dealbreaker before a call, without sending him my contract; I'm free Thursday or Friday afternoon.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Aaron, I'm interested. One thing before we book a call: my current contract has a six-month non-compete covering competitors. Could you check whether Norvale's hiring team would be open to working with that? If so, I'm free for a call Thursday or Friday afternoon.
cases.note: Share that the clause exists, not the contract itself, and have an employment lawyer read it before you resign.

cases.situation: An agency recruiter, Rachel, emailed about a finance manager role at a manufacturing company that sounds right for me. Before she'll submit me she wants names and numbers for three references, including my current manager, who doesn't know I'm looking. I can send my CV today and talk Thursday afternoon.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Rachel. I'm interested in the finance manager role and happy for you to put me forward. I share references once there's an offer on the table, and my current manager doesn't know I'm looking, so they won't be one until I've accepted. I can send my CV today; are you free for a call Thursday afternoon?
cases.note: If she insists references come first, repeat the same line once; a role worth having will not hinge on it.

cases.situation: Recruiter Jess from Halden Analytics, where I was laid off in June, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior analyst role on my old team. I'd consider going back, but only if it's a permanent, funded headcount and the base is at least my old $118k.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Jess. I'm open to coming back to the team. Since my role was cut in June, before a call I'd want to know whether this is a permanent, funded headcount, and I'd need a base of at least $118k, what I was on before. If both check out, I'm free for a call Thursday or Friday afternoon this week.
cases.note: A boomerang offer after a layoff: ask about stability before the call; it is a fair question, not a grudge.

cases.situation: A recruiter, Erin, emailed about a senior product designer role at a home-goods retailer. Before any call she wants me to complete a design challenge that 'takes about 6 hours'. I'm interested, but I won't do a 6-hour task before knowing the range or talking to the team; after a first call I'd do an exercise of around 2 hours, or walk them through a project from my portfolio.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Erin, the role sounds interesting. Before I take on a design challenge, could you share the base range and set up a short call with the hiring manager? If those line up, I'm happy to do an exercise of around two hours, or walk the team through a project from my portfolio instead.
cases.note: A long unpaid task before the range is the same problem as a call before the range, only bigger: offer a smaller version rather than a flat no.

cases.situation: 猎头赵先生在领英上联系我，推荐上海一家医疗器械公司的市场经理岗位。巧的是我上周五已经在他们官网直接投了这个岗位，HR还没回复。我不想被重复推荐，但这个猎头挺靠谱，想保持联系。
cases.reply: 赵先生您好，谢谢您想到我。这个岗位我很感兴趣，不过上周五我已经在他们官网直接投递了，为了避免重复推荐，这次就不麻烦您了。以后有其他市场经理方向的机会，欢迎随时联系我。
cases.note: 已经自己投过的岗位要在第一句就说清，免得公司收到两份简历、说不清是谁推荐的。

cases.situation: My old teammate Ellie moved into recruiting last year and just messaged me on WhatsApp about a product manager role at a retail startup she's hiring for. I'm happy in my job and not looking, but I don't want it to be weird: we get dinner every couple of months and the next one is Friday 9 October.
cases.reply: Thanks for thinking of me, Ellie! This one's a no from me: I'm happy where I am and not looking right now. If that changes, you'll be the first recruiter I call, and I'm glad to pass the role on to anyone I know who'd fit. See you at dinner on Friday 9 October, I want to hear how the new job is going.
cases.note: With a friend who recruits, answer the role like any recruiter's in the first two lines, then keep the friendship separate from it.

cases.situation: A recruiter, Daniel, messaged me on LinkedIn about a senior engineer role. I told him I'm not looking, and he replied asking if I could give him the names of strong engineers on my current team. I'm not comfortable doing that, but I'd consider engineering manager roles from next spring.
cases.reply: Thanks, Daniel. I'd rather not pass on names from my current team; anyone who wants to move can find you here. I'd be glad to hear from you about engineering manager roles from next spring.
cases.note: You don't owe a reason for declining to source your colleagues; one line, then the door you do want open.

cases.situation: A recruiter, Grace, called about an office manager role and then emailed asking my age and whether I'm planning to have children soon, because 'the client likes to know'. I'm interested in the role but won't answer those. I'm free for a call Thursday afternoon.
cases.reply: Thanks, Grace, I'm interested in the office manager role. I won't be sharing my age or family plans, but I'm happy to talk about my experience, the base range and the start date. If the client is still open on that basis, I'm free for a call Thursday afternoon.
cases.note: Decline the question in one line, no lecture; if it keeps coming, check your local equal-treatment rules and consider raising it with the agency.

cases.situation: 我是自由职业的UI设计师，现在只接每周最多三天、全远程的工作。猎头刘女士在微信上联系我，推荐广州一家游戏公司的全职资深UI设计岗位，我对这家公司的项目挺感兴趣。下周二或周三下午我可以通电话。
cases.reply: 刘女士您好，谢谢您想到我。这家公司的项目我挺感兴趣，不过我目前只接每周最多三天、全远程的工作，全职坐班的岗位就不考虑了。如果对方能接受每周三天远程的合作方式，麻烦先告诉我预算范围；合适的话，下周二或周三下午都可以电话聊。
cases.note: 硬性条件放在前两行，再问预算；对方接受不了就到此为止，不用多解释。

cases.situation: 猎头孙女士在微信上给我推荐杭州一家电商公司的运营总监岗位，我挺感兴趣。她发来一份“独家委托协议”让我签字，签了之后三个月内只能通过她们公司投递简历。我不想签独家，但可以接受每个岗位推荐前先经我同意。
cases.reply: 孙女士您好，谢谢您推荐这个岗位，我挺感兴趣的。独家委托协议我这边就不签了，我更习惯每个岗位单独确认：推荐前您先跟我说一声，我同意了再投。这个运营总监的岗位我同意由您推荐，方便的话先把薪资范围发我看看。
cases.note: 不签独家不等于拒绝合作：一句说清，再把感兴趣的岗位往前推；以后签任何协议前都先看清条款。

cases.situation: Holly, an in-house recruiter at my own company, Brookfield Labs, messaged me on Slack about a senior analyst opening on the pricing team. I'm interested, but my manager Paul doesn't know I'd consider moving, and I'd want to tell him myself before anything formal. I'm free Tuesday 6 October after 2pm.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Holly, I'm interested in the pricing role. Two questions before we go further: what level is it, and at what point would Paul be told I'm talking to the team? I'd like to tell him myself first. If that works, I'm free for a chat on Tuesday 6 October after 2pm.
cases.note: For an internal move, your current manager is the stake: ask who gets told and when before the first call.

cases.situation: Fiz a entrevista final para a vaga de analista de dados sênior com a recrutadora Camila no dia 22 de setembro, e ela disse que me daria um retorno até sexta, 25 de setembro. Desde então, nenhuma notícia. Sou o Rafael e quero perguntar sem parecer desesperado.
cases.reply: Oi Camila, tudo bem? Queria saber como está o processo da vaga de analista de dados sênior. Fizemos a entrevista final no dia 22 de setembro e você comentou que teria um retorno até o dia 25. A vaga ainda está aberta? Se o processo tiver seguido outro caminho, sem problema, só me avise para eu me organizar. Abraço, Rafael
cases.note: Se não houver resposta, mande só mais uma mensagem curta uma semana depois e siga em frente.

cases.situation: 猎头吴先生在微信上给我推荐一家做工业软件的创业公司，技术负责人岗位，base 40万，比我现在低，但他说有期权。我对岗位挺感兴趣，约电话前想先知道期权数量、行权价、归属期，以及公司最近一轮融资的情况。10月8日（周四）或10月9日（周五）晚上8点后我都可以通话。
cases.reply: 吴先生您好，谢谢您想到我，这个岗位我挺感兴趣。base比我现在低，所以期权对我很关键，约电话前想先了解几点：期权数量、行权价、归属期，以及公司最近一轮融资的情况。这些合适的话，10月8日（周四）或10月9日（周五）晚上8点后都可以通话。
cases.note: “有期权”不能代替数字；拿到书面条款再判断，签字前最好请懂行的人帮你看一遍。

cases.situation: A recruiter, Marco, messaged me on LinkedIn about a six-month contract-to-hire QA engineer role at Brindle Software. I'm in a permanent job with benefits now, so I'd only consider it at $75 an hour or more and with the conversion terms in writing. I'm free Wednesday 7 October after 4pm.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Marco, the role sounds interesting. Since I'm in a permanent job now, two things before we book a call: what's the hourly rate, and what are the conversion terms? My floor for a contract move is $75 an hour, and I'd need the conversion terms in writing. If those line up, I'm free Wednesday 7 October after 4pm.
cases.note: Contract-to-hire trades your security for a promise, so get the rate and the conversion terms before the call.

cases.situation: A recruiter, Ben, messaged me on LinkedIn about a head of payments role at Luckstone, an online betting company. The pay sounds great, but I don't want to work in gambling, and I don't want to lecture him about it. I'd be open to payments roles in fintech or e-commerce.
cases.reply: Thanks for reaching out, Ben. This one's a no from me: betting isn't an industry I want to work in. I'd be glad to hear about payments roles in fintech or e-commerce, though.
cases.note: A values-based no needs one neutral line, not a justification; naming the door you do want open keeps the recruiter useful.

cases.situation: Une recruteuse, Mme Girard, m'a contactée sur LinkedIn pour un poste de cheffe de projet logistique, et le poste m'intéresse. Avant de me présenter au client, elle me demande d'expliquer le trou de trois ans sur mon CV : de 2022 à 2025, je me suis occupée de ma mère malade, je suis aujourd'hui disponible à temps plein et je ne veux pas entrer dans les détails. Je suis Claire Morel, disponible pour un appel mardi ou jeudi après 14 h.
cases.reply: Bonjour Madame Girard, merci pour votre message, le poste m'intéresse. De 2022 à 2025, j'ai fait une pause professionnelle pour m'occuper d'un proche malade, et je suis aujourd'hui disponible à temps plein. Avant de me présenter au client, pourriez-vous m'indiquer la fourchette de salaire ? Si elle correspond, je suis disponible pour un appel mardi ou jeudi après 14 h. Bien cordialement, Claire Morel
cases.note: Une ligne factuelle suffit pour une pause de carrière, sans détails médicaux ; la question de la fourchette reste avant l'appel.
